PetOwnerRegistration.title: PetOwnerRegistration
PetOwnerRegistration.description: A registered pet owner and their companion pet record.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user managing this registration.

fullName.description: Full legal name of the pet owner (2-100 characters).

email.description: Contact email address of the pet owner (3-120 characters).

mobileNumber.description: Mobile contact number of the pet owner (5-30 characters).

residentialAddress.description: Residential street address of the pet owner (3-250 characters).

petName.description: Name of the registered pet (1-80 characters).

petType.description: Species or category of the pet (e.g., Dog, Cat, Bird, Rabbit, Fish, Reptile, Other).

petBreed.description: Breed or variety of the pet (1-80 characters).

petAge.description: Age of the pet with unit (e.g., '3 years', '6 months', 1-40 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the registration was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the registration was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/pet_owners/{registration.description: Per-user isolated collection of registered pet owners and their pet profiles.
